title: Social
description: Posts on social media, each with the source tag its link carries, and what each brought: the trials asked for, begun and paid for under its tag, counted onto it as they happen by the server that sells workspaces, beside the replies and conversations its author records.

types.title: Post
types.description: One post on one channel, written by a person. Its tag is the ?ref= its link carries (linkedin-26w46-1: the channel, the year and week, its number that week), so each signup is counted onto the post that brought it. Make it part of the work or project it is for, and waits_on whoever writes it. Its note holds the facts it is drawn from; the post itself is its author's.

tag.description: The source tag its link carries (?ref=<tag>): letters, digits, - and _, up to 40. One post, one tag.

url.description: The post itself, once it is out.

replies.description: Replies it drew, as its author counts them.

conversations.description: Conversations it began: replies or messages that said the problem, counted from the conversations that came from it.

impressions.description: Times it was seen, as the channel counts them, typed in at about 3 and 7 days. A weak signal: never summed into a judgement.

reactions.description: Likes and other reactions, as the channel counts them. A weak signal.

reposts.description: Reposts and shares, as the channel counts them. A weak signal.

asked.description: Trials asked for under its tag.

paid.description: Trials paid for, and workspaces bought with no trial, under its tag.

ended.description: Trials under its tag that ended unpaid.

visits.description: Page loads under its tag, as the seller counts them: nothing about the visitor is kept.

first_visit.description: The first day a visit was counted under its tag.

last_visit.description: The last day a visit was counted under its tag.

types.title: Source
types.description: Where visits and signups came from when no post carries their tag: an agent (chatgpt), a search engine (google), a site that linked here, or a post's tag mistyped. Made by the count the first time its tag is seen, titled with the tag and part of the project the posts are in, so each channel is measured beside the posts.

tag.description: The source tag its visits carry (?ref= or ?utm_source=), as the seller reads it.

visits.description: Page loads under its tag, as the seller counts them: nothing about the visitor is kept.

first_visit.description: The first day a visit was counted under its tag.

last_visit.description: The last day a visit was counted under its tag.

asked.description: Trials asked for under its tag.

paid.description: Trials paid for, and workspaces bought with no trial, under its tag.

ended.description: Trials under its tag that ended unpaid.

types.title: Conversation
types.description: Someone who replied or wrote and said the problem they have: a conversation a post began. It is linked came_from the post, or the source it came through, and the post counts it. Its title is the person and the problem in a few words; its note holds what was said.

person.description: Who it is with: their name or handle.

channel.description: Where it is had; the post's channel unless said.

problem.description: The problem they said, in their words.

links.title: came from
links.description: The conversation came from this post, or the source it came through (a tag with no post): what the post's count of conversations is read from.

actions.title: Conversation
actions.description: Record a conversation a post began: someone who replied or wrote and said the problem they have. from is the post (or source) it came from; person who it is with; problem what they said, in their words. The channel is the post's unless given, the day today unless given. It is linked came_from the post, and the post's conversations is counted again from those links.

from.description: Id of the post or source it came from.

person.description: Who it is with: their name or handle.

problem.description: The problem they said, in their words.

channel.description: Where it is had, when not the post's channel.

date.description: The day it began, as 2026-11-04. Today when left out.

note.description: What was said, if there is more.

pieces.label: Conversation
pieces.tip: A reply that said the problem: record it as a conversation this post began
